item.title: Galen Centre Moots Health Service Commission With Ring-Fenced Five-Year Funding
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
The Galen Centre calls for the establishment of a Health Service Commission (SPK) authorised to create and fill positions, and set salary scales, with funding for these positions ring-fenced in a 5-year fiscal framework. MPs have mixed views about the SPK. The post Galen Centre Moots Health Service Commission With Ring-Fenced Five-Year Funding appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Junior Doctors Work 10 To 15 Overtime Hours Weekly Without Pay: MMI
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
MMI says junior doctors in Malaysia work 10-15 unrecorded and unpaid overtime hours weekly. HOs or MOs in Malaysia average at 65-85 weekly working hours, compared to 40 hours in the UK. MMI urges MOH to formalise a Safe Working Hours Policy for doctors. The post Junior Doctors Work 10 To 15 Overtime Hours Weekly Without Pay: MMI appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Newcastle University Admits Malaysia Medical Graduates Deprioritised For UK Training
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Newcastle University admits that medical graduates at its Malaysian campus, NUMed, have been deprioritised for training in the NHS, following the UK's new Medical Training (Prioritisation) Act, but claims that NUMed's MBBS degree is still GMC accredited.
